sum: SCHMID Group N.V. operates as a supplier of equipment and services for various industries, such as printed circuit boards (PCB), substrate manufacturing, photovoltaics, and glass, and energy storage in Germany and internationally. It operates through the Technical Equipment and Processes and Spare Parts and Services segments. The company is also involved in the sale of machines, including installation and extended warranties; and sale of spare parts, as well as services, including repairs, modifications of machines, and inspections. It serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) from semiconductors and consumer electronics, and space and defense electronics industries; companies from hardware and software technology, the electronics, and the photovoltaic industries; and companies that are part of the supply chain of such global companies. The company was founded in 1864 and is based in Freudenstadt, Germany.
ceo: Mr. Christian Mathias Schmid (CEO & Executive Director)
